items.title: Harry Fairconnetue Interview, 1962-11-11
items.q: That's when I got, uh, out of Paul's band and played with old Geese.

ctx.x: And where did that band play?

We split up the jazz between that band and the other band. I had got out of the other band at that time. Uh-huh. And, the jazz was just split up from here, just like I told you, from here to Biloxon, from Bay St. Louis to Pilotson. Out that way the jazz was split up. Well, Chick wasn't playing music then. Yeah. Chick was playing before me. Yeah. Yeah, Chick was playing with old Geese. That's when I got, uh, out of Paul's band and played with old Geese. What was Chick playing?
Band-Dude. What's his name anyway? Eddie Palud.
